subject: Post-call: pricing & token volumes — confirm economic buyer / finance sign-off
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: pricing & token volumes — confirm economic buyer / finance sign-off

Hi Sarah — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can align the pricing ask with your finance/procurement process. Please confirm the items below when you have a moment.

Meeting recap (high level)
- Expected starter volume: ~60M tokens/month; expected ramp to ~120M tokens/month over 9–12 months.
- Peak/day pattern: spikes up to ~8–10M tokens/day during product launches.
- Primary workloads: user-facing assistant (generation) + nightly batch embedding/re-ranking jobs.

Budget & unit economics
- Budget range you indicated: $40k–$80k/month (please confirm).
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: ~$550 / 1M tokens (target), open to committed discounting.

Stakeholder alignment asks
- Economic buyer: please confirm the person who needs to approve the overall spend (name + email).
- Finance sign-off: who on your finance/procurement team signs the PO and typical timing?
- Budget owner: who will own ongoing billing and reporting internally?

Proposed next steps
1) We’ll send a draft pricing proposal with 2 options: a flexible pay-as-you-go band + a committed 12-month discount band.
2) If you can confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact, I’ll request a short intro call (15–20m) to walk through the proposal and timeline for sign-off.
3) We’ll include a simple mutual action plan that maps dates to approvals/PO.

Attachments: I’ll attach a draft proposal in the next email.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <james.park@acme-ai.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing & token volumes — confirm economic buyer / finance sign-off

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the details on our side: 

Volumes and budget
- Initial expected usage: ~60M tokens/month for Q4 → ramp to ~100–120M tokens/month by Q3 next year.
- Budget range: closer to $40k–$80k/month depending on committed pricing and SLA.
- Target unit price: we’re aiming for ~ $550 / 1M tokens but would prefer to see committed pricing tiers.

Stakeholders
- Economic buyer: James Park, CFO (james.park@acme-ai.com). He’ll own the final approval for the budget.
- Procurement contact: procurement@acme-ai.com (they handle POs/contract redlines).
- Budget owner: Product Ops (I manage the forecast but Product Ops owns the budget line).

Timeline
- Finance/procurement typically needs ~2 weeks for review once we have a formal proposal and SOW; if James is looped in early, timeline can be shortened.

Please send the proposal (PDF) with both a month-to-month and a 12-month committed option. Happy to set up a 15m intro between James, procurement, and your team next week — Wed or Thu morning PT works for us.

—
Sarah Lee
Director, Product Ops | ACME AI
sarah.lee@acme-ai.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing & token volumes — confirm economic buyer / finance sign-off

Quick internal note — suggested pricing bands we can include in the draft: 

Option A (Flexible / No commitment)
- $600 / 1M tokens for first 100M tokens, tiered down by usage bands after.
- Monthly billing, no minimum.

Option B (12-month committed)
- $500 / 1M tokens on committed monthly volume (commit tiers: 50M, 100M, 200M).
- 10% additional discount for a 24-month commit or higher SLA.

Add-ons: Dedicated capacity pool (flat monthly fee), retained support/priority routing for production SLOs.

Notes: We should call out unit economics in $/1M tokens and an example cost for their current / projected volumes (e.g., 60M => $30k@500, 120M => $60k@500). Also include a simple mutual action plan and expected finance timelines.

Suggest we position the 12-month committed option as the preferred value path but show the flexible option to avoid gating procurement.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: pricing & token volumes — confirm economic buyer / finance sign-off

Sarah — thanks for confirming. Attached is a short draft proposal with both pricing bands (flexible + 12-month commit) and a one-page mutual action plan. Highlights:

- Draft pricing attached: Redwood_Draft_Pricing_Proposal_v1.pdf
- Example economics called out for 60M and 120M monthly volumes at both price points.
- Proposed next step: 15m intro between James (CFO), procurement@acme-ai.com, and our team to walk through the proposal next Wed 11/4 or Thu 11/5 AM PT. Please let me know which works and who should be included.

If procurement needs any specific contract language or an initial SOW, we can share a clean redline-friendly DocuSign link after the intro.

Thanks — I’ll hold time for Wed/Thu mornings and can adjust based on James’ availability.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
